interactions.hardware_revision: Nitehawk SB V2.0.0 → Cartographer V4 Standard USB
interactions.finding: Manufacturer provides downstream USB device capability, 5V P8/F1 path and signals; exact 5-to-4 pin harness/power rating not confirmed. Direct host USB is proposed primary.

interactions.hardware_revision: Original Nitehawk SB family → downstream USB assumption
interactions.finding: V2 downstream-USB hardware and pin map cannot be applied to original SB; use independently verified direct host USB.
Nitehawk protocol is USB, not CAN. Combined power/data connector is not a CAN port.

interactions.hardware_revision: Reported Rapido2 Fiber UHF PT1000, actual revision unknown → NH SB V2.0.0
interactions.finding: 4.5A maximum continuous HE0 limit is known, purchased heater startup/load and complete current path are not; no heater enable permitted. Historical Octopus swap does not apply.

interactions.hardware_revision: Reported Rapido2 Fiber PT1000 → confirmed NH V2.0.0 TH0
interactions.finding: Documented PB12 ADC/2200 ohm pullup can be configured as PT1000; actual sensor, connector and cold readings must be verified.

interactions.hardware_revision: Leviathan V1.3 H743 versus older generic F446 cfg
interactions.finding: Generic F446/12MHz/no-bootloader firmware header does not apply to V1.3 H743/25MHz/128KiB manufacturer USB diagram.

interactions.hardware_revision: Cartographer V4 Standard Survey6.1.0/new plugin candidate
interactions.finding: Current documentation family matches Survey/new-plugin workflow; actual installed version/interface and exact released pair require validation, no physical test. Classic/original-plugin [scanner] workflow remains omitted.

interactions.hardware_revision: MRW350 unknown magnet variant → Cartographer V4 scan
interactions.finding: If MRW plate has embedded magnets, current scan path is incompatible. Touch mesh is marked unimplemented and is not a workaround. Uniform magnetic sheet differs; actual bed variant unknown.

gates.title: Actual kit/PCB/MCU/PSU identity
gates.evidence_needed: Photos of mainboard/toolboard/fan adapter silkscreen and MCU; PSU labels/selectors; actual fuse/harness labels; kit packing list, separate from current store listing

gates.title: Rapido2 Fiber heater startup and entire electrical path
gates.evidence_needed: Exact hotend revision/voltage/rated current/cold resistance/startup/peak documentation; PCB continuous/pulsed rating; MOSFET, terminal, umbilical/contact, wire, fuse and PSU shared-load ratings

gates.title: MRW bed heater/thermal protection/mains circuit
gates.evidence_needed: Exact bed variant and heater/sensor options; voltage/power/physical bond instructions; thermal fuse data/mounting; SSR/heatsink and fuse ratings; PE lug procedure; qualified inspection

gates.title: Cartographer interface and actual cable
gates.evidence_needed: V4 Standard marking/firmware interface; cable/contact identities; oriented probe/host or downstream P8 pin-to-pin mapping; supply voltage and usable current; chain/umbilical bend/strain requirements

gates.title: Board and Cartographer firmware/driver generation
gates.evidence_needed: Actual board bootloader/firmware and host Klipper versions; compatible released new-plugin/Survey pair; exact binary/hash and installed plugin version/commit; no legacy sections/macros

gates.title: Rigid joint squaring and powered motion prerequisites
gates.evidence_needed: Manual gantry square and smooth full-Z travel; individual motor/corner map and actual motor-current ratings; physical X/Y endstop mount/state; conservative measured travel envelope

gates.title: Magnetic bed/probe geometry and measured envelope
gates.evidence_needed: MRW magnet arrangement (embedded magnets fail current scan path), installed spring sheet, measured probe/nozzle offsets and 2.6-3mm coil/nozzle relationship, safe central reference, QGL points, nozzle/coil reachable mesh bounds

Exact downstream USB P8-to-Sherlock cable if that route is chosen
Heater ferrules/connector contacts fitting actual wires and board
Nitehawk static discharge links and revision-correct fan adapter
